tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm paper in light, near-black in dark. body always sets this explicitly.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Bands (Proof Strip, About teaser, Contact) and placeholder fill. Never a card on every block.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg and surface. 17.3:1 / 16.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, mono labels, meta lines on bg and surface. 7.1:1 / 7.4:1 on bg; 6.5:1 / 6.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary button fill, focus ring, active state. Nothing else. 6.3:1 / 7.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (primary button). 6.6:1 / 7.9:1.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Proof Strip only: a score of 90+ next to the word Pass. Never decoration. 6.2:1 / 10.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only (1.4:1): never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, inputs, badges and placeholders. 3.3:1 / 3.6:1 on bg, meets 1.4.11 non-text contrast.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Websites your team can run, and customers can find.
styles.usage: Home headline and case study title only. 36px under 760px wide.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Resume name and secondary page titles.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Break every concept down three ways

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I design and build fast, accessible, CMS-driven websites.
styles.usage: One intro paragraph under a page title, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Seven years in public school classrooms, then six at Full Sail University.

styles.name: secondary
styles.sample: Chapter website rebuild on tools volunteers can maintain.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Proof Strip scores and stat numbers. tabular-nums.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Badges, placeholder labels, outcome lines on cards.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above values (dt). Always muted.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge row gap, list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tablet+ side gutter; card padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of buttons and toggles.
